<thought>Using the ESI‑MS spectrum, the base peak at m/z 141.1154 corresponds to the protonated ion [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 140.108 Da. The formula that best matches this exact mass, considering typical organic elements and the observed isotopic pattern (≈ 9 % M+1, consistent with ~7 carbons), is C₇H₁₂N₂O. This formula yields a calculated monoisotopic mass of 140.09496 Da, within a few 10⁻² Da of the experimental value, and fits the isotopic distribution. Therefore the molecular formula is C7H12N2O.</thought>
<final_answer>C7H12N2O</final_answer>
